summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Churvox Batch 3: Quotes module, Time tracking, Time-based invoicing, Client-job-invoice linking, and Logo asset update. All 17 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI testing verified all Batch 3 features including timer UI, pricing type selectors, quote/invoice workflows, and logo display.
passed_tests: POST /api/quotes with pricing_type=fixed creates quote with correct pricing
POST /api/quotes with pricing_type=hourly_extras, hourly_rate, extras works correctly
POST /api/quotes/{id}/send changes status to 'sent'
POST /api/quotes/{id}/convert creates job from quote, marks quote 'accepted'
POST /api/jobs with pricing_type=hourly and hourly_rate works correctly
POST /api/jobs with pricing_type=fixed_extras and extras array works correctly
POST /api/jobs/{id}/timer/start starts timer and changes job to 'in_progress'
POST /api/jobs/{id}/timer/pause pauses timer and saves elapsed time
POST /api/jobs/{id}/timer/resume resumes timer correctly
PATCH /api/jobs/{id}/timer/adjust sets total_time_seconds (employer only)
GET /api/jobs/{id}/timer returns current timer state
Hourly job completion: invoice subtotal = hours_worked * hourly_rate
Fixed+extras job completion: invoice subtotal = price + sum(extras)
Invoice workflow: draft → send → mark-paid works correctly
Invoice has job_id link to source job
GET /api/clients/{id}/jobs returns job history for client
Worker cannot adjust time (returns 403)
Job Form page: Pricing type selector with 4 options (Fixed/Hourly/Fixed+Extras/Hourly+Extras)
Job Form page: Hourly rate input visible when hourly pricing selected
Job Form page: Add Extra button and extras input fields visible when extras pricing selected
Job Detail page: Time Tracker card with HH:MM:SS display
Job Detail page: Start/Pause/Resume buttons for timer
Job Detail page: Adjust time button visible for employers
Job Detail page: Complete Job button visible for in_progress jobs
Quote Form page: Client selector, Job Type selector, Pricing Type selector
Quote Form page: Extras input fields when pricing type includes extras
Quote Detail page: Send Quote button (draft status)
Quote Detail page: Convert to Job button (sent/accepted status)
Quote Detail page: View Job link (after conversion)
Quote Detail page: Pricing type and extras breakdown displayed
Invoice Detail page: Draft → Send → Mark Paid action buttons
Invoice Detail page: Line items, hours worked, extras breakdown, GST, total displayed
Invoice Detail page: View linked job link
Client Detail page: Job History section with job count and list
Logo uses new uploaded PNG URL (customer-assets.emergentagent.com)
Logo has mix-blend-mode: screen (no visible background box on dark backgrounds)
Logo appears in sidebar, login, signup pages - logo only, no text wordmark
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up during API tests. Existing jobs/quotes/invoices used for UI testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Churvox Batch 3 is complete. Features added: (1) Quotes module with pricing types (fixed/hourly/fixed_extras/hourly_extras), send, and convert-to-job. (2) Time tracking with timer endpoints (start/pause/resume/adjust) and live HH:MM:SS display. (3) Time-based invoicing with automatic calculation based on pricing type. (4) Client-job-invoice linking. (5) Logo asset updated to new PNG URL with mix-blend-mode: screen. Batch 1+2 features remain intact. Worker john@churvox.com exists with password Worker123!.
